_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
ducks: The Ducks' season runs late August to November at Autzen Stadium, six or seven home Saturdays in the Big Ten, with the Civil War against Oregon State every other year and the Big Ten title game and the College Football Playoff in December.
ducksbasketball: Oregon men's basketball tips off in early November at Matthew Knight Arena, with the Big Ten schedule from December to early March and the conference tournament and March Madness after it.
duckswomens: Oregon women's basketball opens in early November at Matthew Knight Arena, with the Big Ten schedule through February and the tournaments in March.
beavers: The Beavers' season runs late August to November at Reser Stadium in Corvallis, six or seven home Saturdays, with the Civil War against Oregon every other year.
beaversbasketball: Oregon State men's basketball tips off in early November at Gill Coliseum in Corvallis, with the Pac-12 schedule from December to early March and the conference tournament after it.
